sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Restricted heat airflow: airflow is below the minimum, and the furnace is in a 1-hour soft lockout.
diySteps: Turn the furnace off and replace a dirty filter with the size printed on the old filter. Point the arrow the way the old one faced
Make sure return and supply grilles are open
Technician: check blower performance if a clean filter does not let the next heat call finish. The code clears when a heat call finishes successfully
proAdvice: E291 is the airflow lockout, and the manual names a dirty filter. E250 is the open limit circuit and does not use that filter sentence. If a new filter does not clear E291, call a licensed HVAC technician.
